leo-tolstoy.chto-takoe-iskusstvo: Russian printed before 1918: the transcriptions at hand are in the reformed spelling and do not stand letter for letter on the printed page; the line's rule for such works is not written yet.
immanuel-kant.kritik-der-urteilskraft: Already in the bonsai from the Bonn transcription of the Akademie edition, compared with a fresh OCR of its Fraktur pages; its further places follow that route.
mahima-bhatta.vyaktiviveka: Sanskrit: the kit's word comparison is made for alphabetic scripts written with spaces and has not been tried on Devanagari.
yoshida-kenko.tsurezuregusa: Japanese: the kit's word comparison needs words divided by spaces.
john-of-damascus.on-holy-images: The layer dates the English translation of 1898; the Greek original needs its own edition and a decision on the witness.
